preservedFirstResults.disposition: Stopped before scenario execution because early engineer receipts hashed serialized Node Buffer JSON rather than raw bytes. Confirmed exact serialized digest match; no runtime drift. Current repair freeze uses raw SHA256.

Three true defects reproduced on stable initial bytes: number and brand each dispatched a paid POST after tenant replacement in the final awaited callback; an unbound retained old-account operation was falsely marked released from another account404. All3 pass after the repair.

fixtureIntegrity: Reusable synthetic protocol and client/offer factories are taken from the existing scoped check. Independent scenarios are separate. Repair-era registration fixtures add the exact saved synthetic phone-parent prerequisite required by trusted final authority; no execution gate or financial guard is bypassed. Physical Node socket/TLS/http/http2/dgram transport is blocked; SDK/provider fetches return only fixed local protocol evidence.
limitations: Actual engines and Twilio adapters run only against synthetic memory/installed-SDK protocol doubles. No real env-file, account, network, provider/model/email call, purchase, cloud change or publication occurred.

Configured limits are conservative lifetime resource/fee/monthly-commitment reservations; they are not measured provider rates or a complete account bill. Usage/voice costs, invoice reconciliation, refunds and account migration are outside this slice; paid corrections remain explicitly blocked.

Independent cases cover positive number/brand dispatch and campaign denials; broader positive campaign/registration and permanent regressions are separately recorded by engineering, not claimed as independent executions.
No application or permanent-test edits by independent QA. Root owns the separate39-command gate, documentation, commits and any publication/provider approval.
